youtube.script: Can Canva AI replace your design shuffle? Canva says AI 2.0 is available today as a research preview, and it goes beyond one-shot image generation. The update adds conversational design, iterative editing, layered object intelligence, living memory, connectors, scheduling, web research, brand intelligence, Sheets AI, and Canva Code 2.0. For creators and small teams, that matters because it could move work from prompt to edit to publish without jumping between tools. It is still a preview, so expect rough edges and rollout changes. Would you start with a social graphic or a simple landing page? Comment with the one test you'd run first.
